name: Tialo
source:
Tialo is the son of Lord Elric and Lady Thalissa. Young and arrogant, he is noted to be quite surly when [url=/c153095/]Your Character[/url] meets him. When he learns they are [spoiler]his older half-sibling[/spoiler], he acts discourteously until Thalissa calls him out on it, saying that he will address Your Character with respect. As a result, he later tries to adapt what Your Character calls "bland courtesy," but his distaste and contempt still show. He enjoys the Fae life, the revelry and the balls, and looks down upon mortals, [spoiler]even if they're half-supernatural beings: Tialo refers to Your Character as half-mortal rather than as half-Fae, unlike Elric and Thalissa. He also prefers the company of full-blooded Fae[/spoiler]. 

He sees only the beauty of the Fae Realm but none of its flaws. Lord Elric says Tialo is clever, intuitive, and sweet, but is deeply bitter and resentful at the life they chose for him. He is stubborn and selfish and, according to Elric, never learns. [spoiler]Even though both Your Character and Tialo are Lord Elric's children, he sees himself as a duke's son and Your Character as a foundling. His statement that everything [in Lamrian] is his by right shows his classist beliefs.[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Tialo]Wiki[/url]]
